scope: Local/offline helper; no contract/source, service, site, chain, journal or signer changes.
input_contract: Exact current source contract name and full canonical signature from the callable reference. Named nested arguments follow its labels; explorer output orders tuples recursively.
hash_algorithm: SHA-256, output as 0x plus64 lower-case hex digits.
preimage: ASCII bytes ZZZ_POPL_OPERATOR_REVIEW_V1 followed by LF, then json.dumps(manifest,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False). No trailing newline in canonical manifest.
marker: Every exact bytes32 reviewHash/reviewed ABI field uses literal $REVIEW_HASH in the preimage; derived hash replaces it only in ordered explorer output. Never use it for custodyHash/portfolioHash.
units: Every ABI integer, chain ID, snapshot height and timestamp is a canonical decimal STRING. Signed ticks preserve minus signs; booleans are JSON true/false; addresses and bytes use lowercase0x hex.
output: --output creates a new UTF-8 file exclusively; existing files are never overwritten. Validation/source refusal creates no output. A disk write failure can leave a partial new file, so a failed write must not be used; check rejects incomplete/malformed artifacts.
no_qualification: Declared chain/block/runtime/governance are supplied metadata. No RPC, runtime, freshness, authority, operational guard or simulation claim. ready_for_submission=false. Contract checks nonzero provenance only, not this preimage.
remaining: A human must read exact live governance/module versions/bindings/custody/nonce/epoch/physical fingerprint and simulate the full actual call through separately approved read tools.
An explorer is only a transport UI. A matching ABI and local review artifact do not authorize fixed-module/callback functions for a human wallet.
Changing source/catalog/arguments/evidence requires a new review; never update pins blindly or substitute the review hash for an on-chain fingerprint.
